summarize_model_inspection: summarize a PyTorch model into a transformers-style hierarchical string with grouped identical layers
format_model_tree: format a PyTorch nn.Module tree with indentation and collapse identical numbered layers into ranges
get_module_info: get a formatted info string for a PyTorch module including quantization method and extra_repr details
format_index_ranges: format a list of integer indices into compact range notation like '0-2, 4-6'
detect_duplicate_layers: detect duplicate or identical child modules in a PyTorch model by comparing structure signatures
